name: PlateauXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Valley Audio's Plateau reverb from VCV Rack, patched: every CV input on a built-in source (four Bogaudio LFOs, Tidal Modulator 2, Random Sampler, step and gate sequencers) synced to the MPC tempo, a brickwall limiter, Panic and 16 presets, each page drawn like its module.
